lines: If you could ask Allah for anything... would you ask for this first? One king did.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, became prophet and king after his father, Prophet Dawud, alayhis salaam.
And he made a dua: My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
Did you hear it? Forgiveness first... then the kingdom.
And Allah answered. So We subjected to him the wind, blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed.
A morning's journey on that wind was a month. An evening's journey, another month. And Allah made a spring of molten copper flow for him.
But with all of it came one command: Work, O family of Dawud, in gratitude. And few of My servants are grateful.
Few are grateful... would he be one of the few?
Years later, a queen's throne was placed before him in a blink. And he said: This is from the favor of my Lord.
So before you ask Allah for more today... ask Him for forgiveness first. أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ.
